meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: A new hire: talent acquisition HR and BU HR approve, background check is clear, and the agent proposes the account using the hire event
results.expected_in_words: The account is created but stays disabled until the start date, then is switched on, with only the birthright access for the job code

results.title: The agent asks for an account with no hire event, then with an event number it made up
results.expected_in_words: Both refused: no account without an approved HR event

no_event.reason: no approved HR hire event backs this request

made_up_event.reason: no approved HR hire event backs this request

results.title: A pre-hire whose background verification is still pending
results.expected_in_words: No hire event exists until the check is clear; then it does

results.title: Only one of the two HR approvals is given, then the same person tries to give both
results.expected_in_words: No event after one approval; the same person cannot give both; a second person completes it

results.title: The HR record holds PAN, Aadhaar and bank details: what reaches the identity system and its log?
results.expected_in_words: Only the fields identity needs. None of the three appears in the account, the event or the log

results.title: The agent proposes extra access because the new hire's peers have it, including a combination that is not allowed
results.expected_in_words: Nothing is granted by the proposal. Safe extras wait for the manager, and the toxic one is refused

loan.approve.reason: toxic combination with a role already held

results.title: The offer is withdrawn after the account was created but before the start date
results.expected_in_words: The account is disabled and never switched on

results.title: Day one: the new hire tries a sensitive app without MFA enrolment, then without the signed acceptable-use policy
results.expected_in_words: Each is refused until both are done, then access works

details.mfa_but_no_policy: the acceptable-use policy is not signed

results.title: A vendor worker with no sponsor, then no end date, then no security review
results.expected_in_words: Each gap is refused; a complete record gets an account with an expiry date

each_gap.no sponsor: a vendor worker needs a named sponsor
each_gap.no end date: a vendor worker needs an end date
each_gap.no security review: the vendor's security review is not done

results.title: A vendor worker's end date arrives and nobody remembers to remove the account
results.expected_in_words: The account is disabled on its own on the end date

results.title: An administrator creates an account directly in the directory, with no HR record. Does reconciliation notice?
results.expected_in_words: The reconciliation flags the account; accounts made from hire events are not flagged

results.title: A second hire record carries the same PAN as an existing employee
results.expected_in_words: Held for HR review: no event until a person clears it
